topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I tell ye, this morn I found a box at my door, not mine, but the last one what lived here. What’s the world coming to, I ask ye, sending folk the wrong things? I’ve got my own troubles, the barn’s near falling, the sheep ain’t as fat as they should be, and now this. Can’t a man have a moment's peace without being tangled in someone else’s business? I’ll have to walk to the village, find the messenger, and sort this nonsense out. Time I don’t have to waste. Saints be my witness, I’m not one to trouble the heavens over mere trinkets, but this, this is a trial too far.
